name: pf-plan-forgemaster-eat
about: plan-forgemaster-eat against the built packages classes, specs instead of the mods' source folders (tools/make_package_scenarios.py). The Devil Forgemaster's eating and Penance stances (plan_forgemaster penance + lunge sections only): the Heresy lunge dodges (the Dash skill) to 10 px under the body, faces up, bobs 1 px every 250 ms with blood out of the body every 300 ms, and the body goes when the devouring ends; a Penance channel dodges to the same spot, faces up and the body shines gold brighter as it runs (penance_light.effect every 150 ms), its 50 mana spent when the channel completes. Shots: eating, penance_light.
